shared_elements: human figure shown frontally with raised arms
justification: Both surfaces include schematic human figures and small disc-like marks, and A's dense sign rows include serpentine forms comparable to B's long wavy snake, but these are generic correspondences. A is a tightly ruled, register-based array of hundreds of small pictographic signs framing two seated/kneeling figures facing inward, whereas B is a sparse open field with a single stick-figure with raised arms beside one enormous meandering line — utterly different in density, composition and figural convention.
